debug.changelog:
ui: redesign DNS settings screen for improved layout and tablet support

- Replace the scrollable `Column` layout with a `LazyColumn` for smoother content handling.
- Implement responsive layout adjustments for tablet screens using a maximum width constraint.
- Introduce radio buttons to allow toggling between Default and Custom DNS modes.
- Wrap the custom DNS text input field in `AnimatedVisibility` to show it only when the custom mode is selected.
- Refactor action buttons to place a conditional full-width reset button below the primary save button.

Refines the app launcher icon by updating foreground and background gradients to a new blue-purple-red color scheme. Adjusts the foreground shadow, reduces body stroke width, and adds a subtle inner highlight rim for improved depth.
